human_message: member.open_subaccount@1.0.0 performs 1 irreversible step(s) (s9) and the capability is 'draft', not 'approved' and the caller did not pass confirm_irreversible=True. An unattended agent committing a transaction on a capability nobody reviewed, or on a call nobody meant to make, is the failure this gate exists for. Approve the artifact and re-invoke with explicit confirmation.
